description: Evaluation benchmarks for the interactive-html (Answer Me With Interactive HTML) skill, verifying intent-driven adaptive layouts, domain-native interactive controls, real vanilla-JS micro-algorithms, 60fps canvas/SVG simulations, and sandbox compliance without cookie-cutter templates.

evals.name: git-rebase-vs-merge-dag-sandbox
evals.prompt: answer me with interactive html: what is the difference between git merge and git rebase, and why does rebase rewrite commit hashes?
assertions: Uses a Graph/DAG Command Sandbox topology tailored to Git version history rather than a generic slide viewer
Provides domain-native Git controls (e.g., '+ Commit on main', '+ Commit on feature', 'git merge', 'git rebase main', and 'Reset/Undo')
Maintains a real commit DAG in JS and visually animates how rebase clones feature commits (e.g. C3 -> C3') onto the tip of main with new SHA hashes while dimming orphaned commits
Shows live branch ref pointers (HEAD, main, feature) and explains the Golden Rule of Rebasing
Writes a self-contained .html file inside the project workspace (never /tmp) with zero external network calls

evals.name: transformer-attention-temperature-workbench
evals.prompt: /interactive-html explain how Transformer Self-Attention and LLM Temperature / Top-K sampling work
assertions: Uses a Live Token & Probability Workbench topology tailored to LLMs
Renders an interactive prompt ribbon where clicking or hovering any token draws weighted Bezier self-attention arcs to related context words
Includes live sliders for Temperature (T) and Top-K / Top-P that compute real softmax probabilities exp(logit / T) and dynamically resize next-token probability bars
Allows switching prompt sentences or resolving ambiguous pronouns (e.g. 'it' referring to 'trophy' vs 'suitcase')

evals.name: token-bucket-rate-limiter-60fps-lab
evals.prompt: explain how a Token Bucket API rate limiter works and how it compares to Fixed Window, answer me with interactive html
assertions: Uses a 60fps High-DPI Canvas Particle Simulation paired with a live scrolling telemetry oscilloscope chart
Includes continuous sliders for Arrival Rate, Refill Rate, and Bucket Capacity plus a Hold-to-Flood Burst trigger
Includes a simultaneous multi-lane comparison showing how Fixed Window suffers from boundary stampedes while Token Bucket absorbs valid bursts

evals.name: btree-vs-fullscan-storage-studio
evals.prompt: answer me with interactive html: how does a database B+ Tree index find a row so much faster than a Full Table Scan, and when does the query planner ignore it?
assertions: Renders a side-by-side Disk Page I/O Race comparing sequential heap page scans against a 3-hop B+ Tree traversal
Includes a live 'Bring Your Own Keys' B+ Tree insertion sandbox that demonstrates 50/50 leaf page splits and separator promotion
Includes an interactive Query Planner selectivity cost-crossover curve showing when Sequential Scan beats random Index I/O
